summary: Close the equivalent fail-open path for a present Semantic OS ontology block whose begin checksum token is malformed and currently gets mistaken for an absent graph.
decisions: Apply namespace-presence fail-closed detection to the embedded Semantic OS ontology block, not only the runtime policy block.
Allow a truly ontology-free custom card document to keep its existing local-card fallback.
Validate partial begin/end/typed-fence sentinels and malformed checksum tokens before returning ontology=None.

gate_results.evidence: A non-hex first checksum character made BEGIN_RE miss the present Semantic OS block; parse_color_reference_text returned semantic_ontology=None and the default loader silently rebuilt an 88-node/174-edge local graph from visible cards.

risks: Custom card-only documents without an embedded graph are supported and must not be rejected when no ontology namespace sentinel exists.

The generated COY catalog is derived evidence; malformed catalog markers should at minimum be detected by sync, and may share the namespace guard if this can be added without changing the 87-card parser contract.
next_action: Token Curator adds ontology namespace guards and regression tests, assesses the generated catalog marker for the same class, reruns all gates, and publishes a new superseding completion handoff.
